description: Experiment 3 (RQ6): within-family scale replication. Select a model with NEOLOGISM_MODEL=<key>. Everything except the model and its dtype comes from experiments/experiment_2/configs/default.json.
dataset_note: The committed Experiment 2 pairs, held-out prompts and screening outputs are reused unchanged, so the rejected answers are Qwen2.5-0.5B's own concise outputs rather than the larger model's. Per-model re-screening is refused (NEOLOGISM_RESCREEN=1 raises).

qwen2.5-0.5b.note: Reference. Its canonical results come from Experiment 2 (outputs/experiment_2). This entry exists for a bf16 dtype control (NEOLOGISM_DTYPE=bfloat16) and for local smoke tests of the scale code path.

qwen2.5-1.5b.note: float32 weights are about 6.2 GB, well inside an L4's 24 GB, so this keeps the 0.5B run's numerics.

qwen2.5-3b.note: float32 weights would be about 12.3 GB plus an estimated 5-7 GB of backward activations (no gradient checkpointing in eval mode), too close to an L4's ~22 GB usable. bfloat16 halves the weights to about 6.2 GB; the trainable vector keeps a float32 master copy. On an A100 set NEOLOGISM_DTYPE=float32 to remove the dtype difference.
